name: adr-writing
description: Write and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) — when to write one, the standard format, status lifecycle, how to link related decisions, and how to surface ADRs in a codebase. Use when asked to "write an ADR", "document this decision", "architecture decision record", "why did we choose X over Y", or "we need a record of this choice". Do NOT use for: general documentation writing — ADRs are specifically for significant architecture decisions.
